provenance: Lead-authored before model generation to check budget feasibility; withheld from writers/readers. Not a model output or a measured improvement.
text: Count players, check numbered sleeves and date the count in the green ledger. If one is missing, record its number and last-seen time; keep the check incomplete and notify the lead before leaving. If absent, write “pending lead review” and notify the building manager before locking up; they cannot authorise disposal or replacement. Initial only if all players are present.
